widgets_values:
Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.

widgets_values:
<Picture 1> and <Picture 2> as character references, <Picture 3> as the environment background.

SHOT 1: 0-5 seconds. The scene opens in the vintage ballroom <Picture 3>. <Picture 1> (the Chinese beauty) and <Picture 2> (the green ogre gentleman) stand in the center, locking eyes intensely. <Picture 2> gently places his large hand on <Picture 1>'s waist, and they begin a slow, passionate tango step. The camera slowly pushes in, capturing the dramatic size contrast and their deep eye contact.

SHOT 2: 5-10 seconds. The rhythm intensifies. <Picture 2> leads <Picture 1> into a breathtaking, fast spin. <Picture 1>'s crimson red dress flares out beautifully in a circle. <Picture 2> then smoothly dips <Picture 1> slightly, showing incredible gentleness and strength. The camera performs a dynamic 180-degree orbit around them, emphasizing the fluid motion and the romantic spotlight.

SHOT 3: 10-15 seconds. They strike a final, classic tango pose. <Picture 1> arches her back gracefully, looking up at <Picture 2> with a charming, breathless smile. <Picture 2> looks down at her with deep affection and pride. The spotlight focuses tightly on their faces as the music ends. Cinematic lighting, 8k resolution, smooth motion, highly detailed fabric physics.
